{{Quote|A new Mauler chieftain is grabbing for power over the old leader. He's planning to attack Keren with a large force.|[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Gregar Typho/Legends|Typho]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:TPW" />}}
The '''Mauler Usurper''' was a leader of the [[Maulers]], a criminal group that operated on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:TPW" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline" /> he planned to attack the city of [[Keren/Legends|Keren]] with a large force, in an effort to show up the old Mauler leader and take over the Mauler gang for himself. However, the project was discovered by the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] and the Mauler [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] was killed during a [[Royal Security Police Force]] [[Royal Security Forces police raid on Mauler base|operation]] in the [[Mauler Stronghold]].<ref name="SWG:TPW" />

==Behind the scenes==
Doogal Belstar appeared as a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:TPW" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Doogal Belstar was added to the game as part of the "[[W:c:swg:Legacy Quest|Legacy Quest]]" with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>
